ArcelorMittal Leases Hyderabad Office Space Amidst Rising India Leasing

ArcelorMittal has leased 82,823 square feet of office space in Hyderabad, with a total rent exceeding ₹35 crore. This expansion contributes to a broader trend of increased office leasing in India. Overall office space leasing in India rose by 7% year-on-year to 41.6 million square feet in the first half of 2026, according to Savills India. Hyderabad is noted as a key driver of this growth.
